Il Lombardia 2026 - Race profile

Bergamo > Como, 239.0km

10.10

Paul Seixas (Decathlon CMA CGM) produced a historic performance on Saturday, soloing to an emphatic victory in Como to become the youngest ever winner of Il Lombardia.
